digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture infrastructure - nested test session temporary directory management
propositions: Nested pytest children executed without explicit --basetemp allocate pytest's user-global numbered temp root and delete unrelated cleanup-eligible trees at session finish

Two direct subprocess launchers (test_engine_dir.py and test_scripts_import_convention.py) execute nested pytest under repository autouse fixtures without passing a parent-owned basetemp, violating the isolation invariant

When a nested pytest child allocates the shared numbered root via TempPathFactory.getbasetemp, pytest_sessionfinish registers and executes cleanup for that root, deleting unrelated sentinel files from concurrent runs

Fix requires both affected test launchers to accept parent tmp_path and pass a unique child-specific --basetemp (tmp_path/mixed-module-pytest and tmp_path/standalone-pytest) to isolate cleanup ownership to the parent session

Existing safe patterns in tests/_store_isolation.py and tests/unit/test_external_isolation.py demonstrate that parent-owned basetemp assignment prevents the defect without breaking entrypoint, cwd, selector, plugin, or assertion contracts
